tasks.name: Watch For You feed (warm-up)
tasks.notes: v84.4: the ONLY safe automated TikTok task — warmFeed() watches 3-6 For You videos with human dwell (15-45s each). Pure passive session warming.

tasks.name: Follow users
tasks.notes: MANUAL ONLY — automation cannot pick who to follow. Use: !tt follow <username> (1-3/day max).

tasks.name: Comment on videos
tasks.notes: MANUAL ONLY — automation cannot pick which video to comment on. Use: !tt comment <videoUrl> <message> (2-4/day max).
